records.title: mHC: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections
records.summary: Replaces the residual connection paradigm (x + f(x)) used in every major transformer for the past decade. Projects residual paths onto Birkhoff Polytope manifold — neither explode nor collapse at any depth.

records.title: Less is More: Recursive Reasoning with Tiny Networks
records.summary: A 7M parameter model beats DeepSeek-R1, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and o3-mini on ARC-AGI benchmarks. Proves recursive reasoning can compensate for massive parameter counts.

records.title: Holographic Transformers

records.title: Recursive Self-Aggregation for Deep Thinking
records.summary: Test-time scaling via evolutionary algorithms — combines parallel and sequential scaling. Enables Qwen3-4B to compete with DeepSeek-R1 on AIME and LiveCodeBench.

records.title: Agentic Context Engineering (ACE)
records.summary: Makes fine-tuning potentially irrelevant — evolves the context instead of weights. Delta updates and grow-and-refine mechanisms. 59.5% on AppWorld (+10.6pp).

records.title: Verbalized Sampling
records.summary: Recovers 66.8% of base model diversity hidden by RLHF alignment. Single prompting technique: ask LLMs to generate multiple responses with probability estimates. 2x diversity, zero safety loss.

records.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Outperforms RL
records.summary: Prompt optimization via evolutionary search outperforms GRPO by 10-20% while using 35x fewer rollouts. Also beats MIPROv2 by 10%+.

records.title: Drag-and-Drop LLMs: Zero-Shot Prompt-to-Weights
records.summary: Eliminates per-task fine-tuning — maps task prompts directly to LoRA weights via hyper-convolutional decoder. 12,000x lower overhead than full fine-tuning.
